result.reason: The operative language gives Customer the preferred 30-day convenience-termination right with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees for the post-termination period, and Kubient cannot terminate for convenience before the end of the then-current committed term. However, adding a right to terminate “any Exhibit,” “in whole or in part,” materially expands Customer’s rights beyond the playbook and is not necessary to achieve the required position. The retained fees-during-the-termination-period sentence is also potentially ambiguous when read with the refund obligation, although the provisions can be reconciled.
